fit_reason: This is a polyethylene recreational kayak, not a car, truck, motorcycle, boat with gelcoat, PWC or pontoon. Rotomolded plastic doesn't take buffing or gelcoat polishing, so there is little a detail service could do for it.
findings: Light surface scuffs and scratches in the polyethylene on the bow deck near the Loon logo
Fine scuffs on the hull near the PolyLink 3 stamp
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Old Town Loon kayak. It looks well kept from the photos. We mainly detail cars and boats with paint or gelcoat, so a plastic kayak isn't really something we'd work on. Good luck with the sale.
